edits.src:
; v0.2.2: a behavior is read with a block's grammar (:type, sketch, ports, implements); message types take
; :type too; a behavior may implement (extend) others, with arguments for a parameterized one.
(shape Edit :type "struct" (sketch "One change to a note."))
(shape Entry :type "record" (~ What the journal keeps. ~))
(behavior (Store T) :type "trait"
  (takes T :as put)
  (gives T :as get)
  (sketch "Keeps values of T."))
(behavior Durable :type "Protocol"
  (implements (Store Edit))
  (gives Entry :as ack)
  (sketch "Keeps every edit until it is on disk."))
(behavior Journaled (implements Durable) (sketch "Durable, and replays what it kept."))
(behavior (Cache K) (implements (Store K)) (sketch "A Store that may forget."))
(block App
  (behavior Local (sketch "Visible inside App only."))
  (level
    (block App.Editor (gives Edit) (sketch "Saves through a Durable it is given."))
    (block App.Root (sketch "The composition root: makes the store and hands it to the editor.")))
  (level
    (block App.Disk :type "Module" (implements Journaled))
    (block App.Mem (implements (Cache Entry)) (implements Local))))
(block Tools (sketch "Outside App."))
(behavior Tools (sketch "A behavior with a block's name."))
